title: Why Rituals and Fasting Won't Lead You to God (1986-01-25)
description:
Disillusioned by superficial rituals, paid gurus, or empty social work? Discover the true mechanism of spiritual ascent and how to feel it within.

In this revealing media interview, Shri Mataji addresses the commercialization of spirituality, false gurus, and superficial religious rituals. She explains that true yoga is an inner ascent (Kundalini awakening) that manifests as verifiable cool vibrations on your central nervous system.

Key Topics:
• 💬 Why authentic spirituality and Kundalini awakening can never be purchased, exposing the illusion of commercial faith
• 🧠 Understanding why fasting, physical torture, and empty rituals do not please the Divine, but distance us from inner joy
• ⚡ Decoding the subtle system: How self-realization allows you to feel the state of your chakras directly on your fingertips
• 🌍 The spiritual significance of India as the yogabhoomi (land of yoga) and its role in the world's collective consciousness
• 🙏 Why true transformation comes from inner spiritual awakening rather than just external social work or intellectual debates

“Because for Kundalini awakening, you cannot pay money. That is the first principle, is you cannot pay money for God.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to know if a spiritual guru is genuine or fake?
• What does it mean to feel cool vibrations on hands?
• What is the spiritual meaning behind religious fasting?

Have you ever felt disillusioned by modern commercial spirituality? What did it feel like when you first discovered true, spontaneous meditation?

Archival audio recording of an interview with H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi in Chennai (Madras) (India).
